title: Obsidian
body:
Description

Obsidian can spawn only in Blackstone and Lavaslate nodes, though if a piece of Magmite cools fully, it can be in Flameslate.

The raw form of Obsidian takes on a deep navy-blue shade.

Putting Obsidian in a refiner raises the sell price to $180 per stud. Putting that refined Obsidian through a forge further increases the price to $220 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Obsidian to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Unlike most ores, Obsidian will instead take a stone-like appearance when forged, similarly to Lithium.
  • Obsidian appears to have been silently heavily nerfed in the 1.95.0 Secret Update. It previously sold for $350/stud forged.
